name: @pipeworx/mcp-bodacc

tools.name: bodacc_company_events
tools.description: Full BODACC event history for one French company: every dated notice published for it — creations, insolvency proceedings (redressement/liquidation judiciaire), business sales/transfers, deregistrations, modifications, account filings, conciliation. Look up by SIREN (the 9-digit id shared with the entreprises-fr and insee packs — chain a SIREN from either into this tool) or by company name. Sorted newest first. Use this to answer "has this supplier entered insolvency / sold its business / been deregistered?"

siren.description: 9-digit French SIREN identifier, e.g. "805243102" (spaces ignored). Preferred over name — exact match.

name.description: Company name (commerçant/dénomination) to search when SIREN is unknown, e.g. "Marine Services Maintenance". Free-text, matches any word.

event_type.description: Restrict to one event family — one of: creation, immatriculation, collective, conciliation, retablissement_professionnel, modification, radiation, dpc, vente, divers. English aliases also accepted: sale/transfer→vente, insolvency/bankruptcy→collective, deregistration/deletion→radiation, accounts→dpc, registration→immatriculation. Omit for the full history.

limit.description: Number of notices to return (1-100). Default 20.

tools.name: bodacc_search
tools.description: Search all BODACC notices across every French company by free text (searched across the whole notice — company name, activity, judgment/act text, addresses — not just the name), event family, département, and/or publication date range. Returns the most recently published notices first, each shaped with SIREN, company name, event family, court (greffe), location, and notice detail. Use for open-ended discovery (e.g. "insolvency notices in Lyon since August" or "business sales in Paris this month") — use bodacc_company_events instead when you already have a SIREN or exact name. Use `name` instead of `q` when you specifically want to match the company name/denomination only.

q.description: Free-text search across the whole notice (company name, activity description, judgment/act text, address, etc). Omit to list by filters/date alone.

name.description: Search the company name (commerçant/dénomination) field only, instead of the whole-notice free text of `q`.

event_type.description: Event family — one of: creation, immatriculation, collective, conciliation, retablissement_professionnel, modification, radiation, dpc, vente, divers (collective=insolvency, vente=sale/transfer of business, radiation=deregistration, creation=new registration, modification, dpc=account filing, conciliation, retablissement_professionnel, immatriculation, divers). English aliases also accepted: sale/transfer→vente, insolvency/bankruptcy→collective, deregistration/deletion→radiation, accounts→dpc, registration→immatriculation.

departement.description: French département code to filter on, e.g. "75" (Paris), "13" (Bouches-du-Rhône), "2A"/"2B" (Corsica).

since.description: Only notices published on/after this date, YYYY-MM-DD.

until.description: Only notices published on/before this date, YYYY-MM-DD.

siren.description: 9-digit SIREN to combine with the other filters (spaces ignored).

limit.description: Number of notices to return (1-100). Default 20.

offset.description: Result offset for pagination. Default 0. offset+limit is capped at 10,000 by the upstream API.

tools.name: bodacc_insolvency_feed
tools.description: Recent French insolvency-proceeding notices (familleavis="collective": redressement judiciaire, liquidation judiciaire, sauvegarde and their related deposit/judgment notices) published since a given date, newest first. Built for monitoring — poll with an advancing `since` to catch new insolvency events. Optionally narrow to a département. For a specific company's status use bodacc_company_events instead.

since.description: Only notices published on/after this date, YYYY-MM-DD. Required.

until.description: Only notices published on/before this date, YYYY-MM-DD. Omit for open-ended (up to today).

departement.description: French département code to filter on, e.g. "75" (Paris).

limit.description: Number of notices to return (1-100). Default 20.

offset.description: Result offset for pagination. Default 0. offset+limit is capped at 10,000 by the upstream API.

tools.name: bodacc_get_notice
tools.description: Fetch a single BODACC notice by its id (e.g. "A202601824309", visible in bodacc_search / bodacc_company_events / bodacc_insolvency_feed results). Returns the full shaped notice including the parsed judgment/act/deregistration/persons detail.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-bodacc forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the bodacc pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
